item.title: Senior Bookkeeper & Accounting Specialist
item.description:
Established civic consulting firm in Oakland seeks an experienced Full Charge Bookkeeper.

Responsibilities include managing accounts payable/receivable in QuickBooks Online, conducting monthly bank reconciliations, and payroll filing via Gusto.

Pay: $32.00 - $36.00 per hour. Standard business hours M-F 9am-5pm.

item.title: Warehouse Inventory & Material Handler
item.description:

Pay: $30/hr.

item.title: Entry Level Junior Bookkeeper
item.description:
Small boutique shop looking for helper to input receipts into QuickBooks.

Compensation: $18.00 / hour to start. Day shift.

item.title: Accounts Clerk - Overnight Shift
item.description:
Hotel auditing role. Reconcile daily guest receipts and night transactions.

Schedule: Graveyard shift 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM, Tuesday through Saturday.

Pay: $31.00/hr.

item.title: Lead HVAC Mechanical Maintenance Technician
